title: Attribution Through the Decoder: Prediction-Space Explanations for Structured Outputs
abstract: arXiv:2611.23161v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Networks that predict angles, gaze directions, and rotations do not output these quantities directly: they emit raw coordinates that a fixed decoder, such as normalization, maps to the final prediction. Attribution methods are usually applied to the raw coordinates, so they can credit inputs for changes the decoder discards, such as rescaling a vector when only its direction matters. The resulting explanation can highlight inputs that have no effect on the prediction. We instead attribute through the decoder differential, which for normalization decoders reduces to a scaled tangent projection. We characterize invariance to output rescaling, show that every fixed smooth scalar target on a sphere has points of zero tangential sensitivity, and show that an endpoint-projected variant of Integrated Gradients can still attribute to scale-only inputs, whereas direct angular Integrated Gradients cannot. translated_title: 通过解码器进行归因：结构化输出的预测空间解释
translated_abstract: 预测角度、视线方向和旋转的网络并不直接输出这些量：它们输出的是原始坐标，再由固定解码器（如归一化）映射到最终预测。现有的归因方法通常作用于原始坐标，因此可能将输入归因于解码器所丢弃的变化，例如在只有向量方向重要时对向量进行缩放。由此产生的解释可能会突出那些对预测没有实际影响的输入。我们转而通过解码器微分进行归因，对于归一化解码器，这可以简化为一个缩放的切向投影。我们刻画了该方法对输出缩放的不变性，证明了球面上每个固定的光滑标量目标都存在零切向敏感度的点，并证明积分梯度的端点投影变体仍然能够归因于仅影响尺度的输入，而直接的角度积分梯度则无法做到这一点。在具有解析已知特性的合成任务上……
tldr: 该论文提出通过解码器微分（对归一化解码器等价于缩放的切向投影）进行归因，避免了将输入错误归因于解码器丢弃的缩放变化，从而为角度、视线方向等结构化输出提供更准确的预测空间解释。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes attribution through the decoder differential—which reduces to a scaled tangent projection for normalization decoders—to avoid crediting inputs for scale changes the decoder discards, yielding more accurate prediction-space explanations for structured outputs such as angles, gaze directions, and rotations.
